description: This file defines the CandidateVacancy entity class used in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It represents a candidate's application for a specific vacancy, including properties such as candidate, vacancy, status, and applied date, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: CandidateVacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's vacancy application in the recruitment system, with properties for candidate, vacancy, status, and applied date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the CandidateVacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the CandidateVacancy.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the Candidate associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this vacancy application.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Retrieves the Vacancy associated with this candidate.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy object with this candidate.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the candidate's application.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the application status for the candidate.

methods.name: getAppliedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the candidate applied.

methods.name: setAppliedDate
methods.description: Sets the application date for the candidate.
